spanish: Y el interior y las dos piernas lavará en las aguas, y acercará el sacerdote el todo, y hará humear hacia el altar; holocausto él, ofrenda de fuego de olor de reposo a Jehová.
grammarChanges: Removed the comma between 'ofrenda de fuego' and 'olor de reposo' and joined them with 'de', since אִשֵּׁה and רֵיחַ are both construct, forming one genitive chain rather than two parallel items: 'ofrenda de fuego de olor de reposo'.
Marked the dual הַכְּרָעַיִם explicitly as 'las dos piernas' (was 'las piernas') so the paired number is not lost in an unmarked Spanish plural.
readerNote: Dual כְּרָעַיִם rendered as 'las dos piernas' rather than unmarked 'las piernas' to keep the paired number visible in Spanish.
